title: Amarcord
description: Federico Fellini's episodic homage to life in a 1930s Italian seaside village as seen through the eyes of a boy.

title: Il bidone
description: Tired of impersonating priests, three small-time swindlers (Broderick Crawford, Richard Basehart, Franco Fabrizi) go their separate ways.

title: The Kissing Bandit
description: A Boston milquetoast (Frank Sinatra) goes West and takes his father's place as leader of an outlaw gang.

title: Love Is a Ball
description: An American heiress (Hope Lange) on the Riviera falls in love with her chauffeur (Glenn Ford), foiling a matchmaker (Charles Boyer).

title: The Singing Nun
description: A Dominican nun (Debbie Reynolds) working in a Belgian slum is urged by a priest (Ricardo Montalban) to record her music.

title: Fiesta
description: A Mexican girl (Esther Williams) poses as her bull-shy twin brother (Ricardo Montalban) in the ring to please their matador father.

title: On an Island With You
description: A Navy pilot (Peter Lawford) kidnaps an aquatic movie star (Esther Williams) and flies her to a private island.

title: Neptune's Daughter
description: A swimwear designer's (Esther Williams) sister mistakes a madcap masseur (Red Skelton) for the captain (Ricardo Montalban) of a polo team.

title: Two Weeks With Love
description: A teenager (Jane Powell) flirts with a foreigner (Ricardo Montalban) while staying with her parents and sister at a Catskills resort.

title: Border Incident
description: A U.S. immigration agent and his Mexican counterpart go undercover to stop traffic in slave labor.

title: Mystery Street
description: A Harvard doctor's (Bruce Bennett) study of a female skeleton leads a Boston police detective (Ricardo Montalban) to a killer.

title: Battleground
description: U.S. soldiers (Van Johnson, John Hodiak, Ricardo Montalban) from all over fight in the Battle of the Bulge.

title: My Man and I
description: A Mexican-American laborer (Ricardo Montalban) loves an alcoholic woman (Shelley Winters) and works for a farmer (Wendell Corey) who cheats him.

title: Right Cross
description: A sportswriter (Dick Powell) forms a ring triangle with a fight manager's daughter (June Allyson) and her Mexican-American boxer (Ricardo Montalban).

title: Old Acquaintance
description: Two best friends from girlhood clash over the years as serious writer (Bette Davis) and racy novelist (Miriam Hopkins).

title: Love Crazy
description: An old flame (Gail Patrick) and a mother-in-law make a couple's (William Powell, Myrna Loy) fourth anniversary wacky.

title: The Long, Long Trailer
description: Newlyweds (Lucille Ball, Desi Arnaz) splurge on a trailer for their honeymoon, which includes Yosemite National Park.

title: Days of Wine and Roses
description: A boozing PR man's (Jack Lemmon) wife (Lee Remick) joins him in drinking but not in Alcoholics Anonymous.

title: Yours, Mine and Ours
description: A widow (Lucille Ball) with eight children meets, courts and weds a widowed Navy officer (Henry Fonda) with a brood of 10.

title: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
description: A professor (Richard Burton) and his wife (Elizabeth Taylor) drink and verbally assault each other in front of a younger couple, their dinner guests.

title: The Way We Were
description: A leftist (Barbra Streisand) and a writer (Robert Redford) meet in college, and their love spans the 1930s and '50s.

title: The Mark of Zorro
description: Foppish Don Diego Vega (Tyrone Power) courts the daughter (Linda Darnell) of a tyrant, whose henchman (Basil Rathbone) he fights as a masked avenger.

title: The Black Swan
description: As governor of Jamaica, buccaneer Henry Morgan (Laird Cregar) sends a swashbuckler (Tyrone Power) to capture renegade pirates.

title: The Exile
description: Exiled Charles II (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.) woos a Dutch innkeeper (Paule Croset) who hides him from Cromwell's Roundheads.

title: The Sea Hawk
description: A British privateer (Errol Flynn) raids Spanish ships with his queen's (Flora Robson) permission in 1585.

title: The Spanish Main
description: Dutch pirates of Tortuga save the Mexican viceroy's daughter (Maureen O'Hara) from marriage to the governor (Walter Slezak).

title: Adventures of Don Juan
description: The Spanish swordsman (Errol Flynn) joins the royal fencing academy and duels a duke (Robert Douglas) who wants to be dictator.

title: The Wicked Lady
description: A 17th-century English aristocrat (Margaret Lockwood) rides and robs for fun with a highwayman (James Mason) by night.

title: The Three Musketeers
description: Swordsmen Athos (Van Heflin), Porthos, Aramis and D'Artagnan (Gene Kelly) foil a plot against the king by Lady de Winter (Lana Turner) and Richelieu (Vincent Price).

title: The Pirate
description: An actor (Gene Kelly) woos a Caribbean islander (Judy Garland) by posing as the pirate (Walter Slezak) of her dreams.

title: MGM Parade
description:
S01 E11
Clip of Judy Garland and Gene Kelly in "For Me and My Gal"; host George Murphy.

title: Look in Any Window
description: A teenager's parents finally realize how bad their home life is when their son is arrested for prowling.

title: Fingers at the Window
description: During a spree of axe murders in Chicago, Oliver sees a sinister figure following Edwina, and escorts her home. As he keeps watch, Oliver spots the man with an axe and tries to catch him to claim a reward.

title: The Window
description: A boy (Bobby Driscoll) sees a murder in his New York tenement, but his parents (Barbara Hale, Arthur Kennedy) do not believe him.

title: Rear Window
description: Sitting in a wheelchair, his leg in a cast, a photographer (James Stewart) spies on courtyard neighbors and sees a murder.

title: Obsession
description: A London psychiatrist suspects that his wife is having yet another affair; when he confirms it, he takes her lover prisoner and taunts his wife about the other man's condition.

title: You Never Can Tell
description: A poisoned German shepherd dog returns to Earth as a man (Dick Powell) to find the killer (Charles Drake).

title: Umberto D
description: A lonely old man struggles to maintain his dignity while leading a meager existence with his dog as his only companion.

title: The Artist
description: The arrival of sound in motion pictures signals the end of one superstar's (Jean Dujardin) career, while a young ingénue (Bérénice Bejo) stands poised to hit the big time.

title: The Great Race
description: The Great Leslie (Tony Curtis) and sinister professor Fate (Jack Lemmon) enter their wacky cars in a 1908 race from New York to Paris.

title: Tribute to a Bad Man
description: An Easterner (Don Dubbins) goes to work for a Colorado rancher (James Cagney) who keeps law and order with a rope.

title: Executive Suite
description: Four VPs and a junior executive (William Holden) jockey for power in a company run by the founder's daughter (Barbara Stanwyck).

title: Blood on the Moon
description: A Texas gunfighter (Robert Mitchum) helps an old friend (Robert Preston) stir up a feud between ranchers and settlers.

title: Born to Kill
description: A private eye (Walter Slezak) hunts a killer (Lawrence Tierney) who marries a divorcee's (Claire Trevor) rich sister.

title: The Set-Up
description: An aging boxer (Robert Ryan) leaves his crying wife (Audrey Totter), then crosses the street for a fixed fight.

title: This Could Be the Night
description: A prim teacher (Jean Simmons) works in a New York nightclub run by a gruff ex-bootlegger (Paul Douglas) and his suave partner (Anthony Franciosa).
